Japan has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

Byzantium has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Seafood Rituals (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from each source of [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crabs, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CAVIAR] Black Caviar and [ICON_RES_REDCAVIAR] Red Caviar. +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from each source of [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish)
Ethiopia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)

Korea has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)

Germany has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Gifts of the Furrow (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each [ICON_RES_RICE] Rice, [ICON_RES_POTATO] Potato, and [ICON_RES_BARLEY] Barley resource)
A golden age begins for the Japanese civilization.
goldar has made peace with Grey!

Byzantium has founded the new religion Eastern Orthodoxy in the holy city of Constantinople:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Voice of Prophets[ENDCOLOR] Great Prophets cost 25% less [ICON_PEACE] Faith. [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Holy Sites[ENDCOLOR] provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Hawk Spirit[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_AQUEDUCT] Aqueducts provide +5 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food.[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Church Property[ENDCOLOR] +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each city following this religion
France has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sacred Waters (+1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from cities on fresh water)
A golden age begins for the Ethiopian civilization.

Ethiopia has founded the new religion Judaism in the holy city of Addis Ababa:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sacred Capital[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +4 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Feed the World[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_SHRINE] Shrines provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] and [ICON_BUILDING_TEMPLE] Temples provide +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food each. [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +5 [ICON_FOOD] Food

Япония основала новую религию Протестантизм в священном городе Киото:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Всемирная церковь[ENDCOLOR] Дает +1 [ICON_CULTURE] к культуре за каждые 6 последователей этой религии[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Набожные лицедеи[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM] Арены дают +1 [ICON_CULTURE] к культуре, [ICON_BUILDING_CIRCUS] цирки дают +1 [ICON_CULTURE] к культуре, [ICON_BUILDING_CIRCUS_MAXIMUS] Большой цирк дает +5 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] к счастью в городе и +4 [ICON_CULTURE] к культуре.

Германия основала новую религию Синтоизм в священном городе Берлин:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Церковная десятина[ENDCOLOR] Даёт +1 [ICON_GOLD] золото за каждые 4 почитателя этой религии[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Религиозное сообщество[ENDCOLOR] +1% [ICON_PRODUCTION] к производству за каждого почитателя (максимум +10%).
